description: Request a free agent-readiness scan of your user's website, when your user asked for it. DataAutomation scans the site against the AI agent standards (discovery files, MCP and A2A, agent ordering, and agent payments) and emails your user a report with their score and what is missing. Free, no obligation. Returns ok, status requested, and next_step.

email.description: Your user's work email. The report goes here

person_consented.description: True only if your user asked for the scan and agreed to get the report by email

website.description: The site to scan, for example yourstore.com

name: request_agent_scan
title: Request a free agent-readiness scan
